steps.script: const s = __vars.before.Settings; const want = {}; for (const k of Object.keys(s)) { const v = s[k]; if (k === 'MirrorToUserData') { continue; } if (typeof v === 'boolean') { want[k] = !v; } else if (typeof v === 'number') { want[k] = v + 1; } else if (typeof v === 'string') { const names = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#UserRatingsSettingsRoot [data-jfur-field="' + k + '"] [role=radio]')).map(b => b.getAttribute('data-jfur-value')); const at = names.findIndex(n => n.toLowerCase() === v.toLowerCase()); want[k] = names[(at + 1) % names.length]; } } want.WhoCanRate = 'SelectedUsers'; want.RaterUserIds = [__vars.viewerId]; want.RateableItemTypes = s.RateableItemTypes.concat(['Trailer']); const root = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsSettingsRoot'); const rowOf = (k) => root.querySelector('[data-jfur-field="' + k + '"]'); const idOf = (x) => String(x).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); for (const k of Object.keys(want)) { const v = want[k]; const r = rowOf(k); if (!r) { throw new Error('no row for ' + k); } if (typeof v === 'boolean') { const b = r.querySelector('[role=switch]'); if ((b.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true') !== v) { b.click(); } } else if (typeof v === 'number') { const i = r.querySelector('input'); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } else if (typeof v === 'string') { const c = r.querySelector('[role=radio][data-jfur-value="' + v + '"]'); if (!c) { throw new Error(k + ' has no choice ' + v); } c.click(); } else if (Array.isArray(v)) { for (const b of r.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')) { const on = v.some(x => idOf(x) === idOf(b.getAttribute('data-jfur-value'))); if ((b.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true') !== on) { b.click(); } } } } return want;
